question: 'Rajagriha' was the capital city of which Mahajanapada in ancient India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Magadh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Rajagriha**, also known as **Rajgir**, was the ancient capital city of the **Magadh Mahajanapada**.

• Magadh was one of the most powerful and prominent **Mahajanapadas** during ancient India, flourishing around the 6th century BCE.

• Rajagriha was strategically located among hills and was well-fortified, providing security and defense against invasions.

• It was famous for being a center of political power and intellectual growth, hosting scholars like **Gautama Buddha** and **Mahavira**.
